blind.description: A circular cluster of five stylized burlap sacks opened at the top, each filled with a mound of brightly colored powdered spice or pigment (yellow-orange, dark brown, vivid red, forest green, and deep maroon). A small brown wooden scoop rests inside the yellow spice sack. The sacks have rolled fabric rims and wrinkled cloth folds, with solid, smooth stylized surfaces sitting directly on the ground.
blind.from_above: A five-petaled rosette arrangement of circular bag openings filled with yellow, maroon, green, red, and dark brown powders, with a small scoop handle protruding from the yellow sack.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.5 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 ft in diameter.
